summary: BioHarvest Sciences Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a strategic leadership transition. CEO Ilan Sobel (since 2020) has transitioned from his executive role to the Board of Directors, while co-founder and Executive Chairman Dr. Zaki Rakib has assumed the CEO role, consolidating R&D, manufacturing, and operations under a unified structure. The change is effective April 29, 2026, with no additional terms disclosed. The board expressed appreciation for Sobel's contributions. This is a C-suite succession rather than a routine management information circular; the abrupt shift of a long-tenured CEO to a board role with a co-founder stepping in marks a material governance change. Monitor future strategic direction and potential operational updates.
